introHtml: Custom 1 oz products are ideal for sampling campaigns, travel kits, and budget-friendly giveaways. Their compact size makes them easy to distribute at trade shows or include in welcome packets. From lip balms to mini hand sanitizers, these small but functional items keep your brand top of mind without taking up much space. Decorate with your logo via screen printing or pad printing for a crisp, professional look.
